test_title: PYST 02: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Each of C, D, E, F, S, T and U has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only two people have the exam before T. Only one person has the exam after D. Only three people have the exam between T and F. Only one person has the exam between E and C. U has the exam immediately before E. Who among the following has the exam on Friday?
solution:
Given: Each of C, D, E, F, S, T, and U has an exam on a different day of a week, 

Starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) Only two people have the exam before T.

2) Only one person has the exam after D.

3) Only three people have the exam between T and F.

4) Only one person has the exam between E and C.

5) U has the exam immediately before E.

Thus, S has the exam on Friday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
